scripts.install: cd client && yarn install && cd ../server && yarn install && cd ../
scripts.start: cd client && yarn start:frontend && cd ../server && yarn start:backend
scripts.start:windows: cd client && yarn start:frontend--windows & cd ../server && yarn start:backend--windows
scripts.start:backend-watch: cd client && yarn start:frontend & cd ../server && yarn start:backend--watch
scripts.start:backend-watch--windows: cd client && yarn start:frontend--windows & cd ../server && yarn start:backend--watch--windows
scripts.build: cd client && rimraf build & react-scripts build
scripts.build:win: cd client && rimraf build && set NODE_ENV=production & set PORT=4000 & react-scripts build
